projectDescription: The official organizational handbook for Open Coral Network / Plural Commons Japan — a civic NPO building self-sustaining local commons through Civic AI, vacant-house third places, and a fair bounty ecosystem.
keyFeatures: Do-ocracy governance with 3-layer decision structure (lazy consensus for daily ops)
4-engine self-sustaining funding model (grants, public-private, hospitality, art/research)
Vacant-house third-place bases (café, coworking, lodging) with 40/60 capacity management
Fair bounty & Local Proof of Action point system for contributors
Nexloom integrated workspace (AI meeting minutes, Pages, task board, 60+ remote MCP tools)
Plural Commons Japan spec (4 commons pillars, art RWA authentication, Zaisei Radar GovTech)
Civic AI tools including Auto-Grants and public finance transparency dashboards
NPO × LLC-DAO dual legal structure with conflict-of-interest firewall
publicApiSurface: Nexloom remote MCP tools (60+ Model Context Protocol endpoints for AI agent integration)
Local Proof of Action QR check-in (LINE login + dynamic QR for on-site contribution tracking)
Zaisei Radar (public finance data visualization dashboard)
